title: Matrix cocycle descent produces a bijective base algebra homomorphism
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-sc-galois-matrix-cocycle-split, there exists a K-algebra homomorphism f : D → M_n(K) that is bijective as a function.

source.place: Tag 03R7, tensor computation and injectivity via vector-space descent

proof.text: Apply matrix Hilbert 90 to the locally constant genuine cocycle b, obtaining an invertible matrix t with b(g) g(t)=t. This step does not involve D or the splitting e.

Define the algebra automorphism C(M)=t inverse * M * t, with inverse M maps to t * M * t inverse. Multiplicativity follows by cancelling adjacent t and t inverse; scalar matrices commute with t. Compose e with C. Taking the inverse of b(g)g(t)=t gives g(t inverse)b(g) inverse=t inverse. Substitute this and b(g)g(t)=t into hdesc to prove every image of 1 tensor a under the conjugated splitting is Galois-fixed. Implemented by matrixConjugation and the displayed calculation in the main theorem.

For each entry of the conjugated splitting use InfiniteGalois.mem_range_algebraMap_iff_fixed to find its unique preimage in K. Construct f entrywise. Injectivity of the coefficient map K to its separable closure proves preservation of zero, one, addition, multiplication and scalar maps by comparing images in the larger matrix algebra. This is the first half of the proved private helper fixed_matrix_descent.

If f(a)=f(c), injectivity of the conjugated e gives 1 tensor (a-c)=0. Module.FaithfullyFlat.one_tmul_eq_zero_iff implies a-c=0, proving injectivity. The conjugated e makes S tensor D finite dimensional over S; Module.Finite.of_finite_tensorProduct_of_faithfullyFlat descends finite dimensionality to K. Module.finrank_baseChange and finrank preservation by e show that D and M_n(K) have equal finite dimension. LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective_of_finrank_eq_finrank gives surjectivity. No positivity of n is needed. This is the remainder of fixed_matrix_descent.

proof_origin.place: Tag 03R7 injectivity argument; fixed-entry descent expanded and formally proved by N2 using infinite Galois fixed fields, faithful scalar extension and dimensions
